package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"strings"

	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
	"go.uber.org/zap"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/queryfields"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1/middleware"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1/parsers"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/catalog"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/course"
)

// CourseHandler exposes course endpoints.
type CourseHandler struct {
	Validator   *validator.Validate
	Logger      *zap.Logger
	GetUC       course.GetCourse
	ListUC      course.ListCourses
	ScopeListUC catalog.ListPublicScopes
	OutlineUC   course.GetCourseOutline
}

// Outline handles GET /course/{courseID}/outline.
func (h CourseHandler) Outline(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	courseID := chi.URLParam(r, "courseID")
	lang := resolveLang(r.Header.Get("Accept-Language"))
	outline, err := h.OutlineUC.Handle(r.Context(), courseID, lang)
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		if err == domain.ErrValidation {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"outline": outline})
}

type courseResponse struct {
	domain.Course
	Title       string `json:"title,omitempty"`
	Description string `json:"description,omitempty"`
	Tags        any    `json:"tags"`
	LessonCount int    `json:"lesson_count"`
	Techs       any    `json:"techs"`
}

// GetBySlug handles GET /course/get-by-slug/{slug}.
func (h CourseHandler) GetBySlug(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	slug := chi.URLParam(r, "slug")
	lang := resolveLang(r.Header.Get("Accept-Language"))
	course, err := h.GetUC.Handle(r.Context(), slug, lang)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	if _, role, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context()); !ok || !isPositionPrivilegedRole(role) {
		if course.Status != domain.CourseStatusActive || !course.CatalogVisible {
			http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
	}
	title, description, tags, lessonCount, techs, err := h.loadCourseMeta(r, course.ID)
	if err != nil {
		h.handleCourseMetaError(w, err)
		return
	}
	resp := courseResponse{Course: *course, Title: title, Description: description, Tags: tags, LessonCount: lessonCount, Techs: techs}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"course": resp})
}

// Get handles GET /course/get/{courseID}.
func (h CourseHandler) Get(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	courseID := chi.URLParam(r, "courseID")
	fieldsParam := r.URL.Query().Get("fields")
	lang := resolveLang(r.Header.Get("Accept-Language"))
	_, role, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	privileged := ok && isPositionPrivilegedRole(role)

	// If fields parameter is provided, use dynamic field selection
	if fieldsParam != "" {
		if !privileged {
			course, err := h.GetUC.HandleByID(r.Context(), courseID, lang)
			if err != nil {
				http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
				return
			}
			if course.Status != domain.CourseStatusActive || !course.CatalogVisible {
				http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
				return
			}
		}
		f := queryfields.Parse(fieldsParam, queryfields.CourseAllowedFields)
		result, err := h.GetUC.HandleByIDWithFields(r.Context(), courseID, f)
		if err != nil {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"course": result})
		return
	}

	course, err := h.GetUC.HandleByID(r.Context(), courseID, lang)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	if !privileged && (course.Status != domain.CourseStatusActive || !course.CatalogVisible) {
		http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	title, description, tags, lessonCount, techs, err := h.loadCourseMeta(r, course.ID)
	if err != nil {
		h.handleCourseMetaError(w, err)
		return
	}
	resp := courseResponse{Course: *course, Title: title, Description: description, Tags: tags, LessonCount: lessonCount, Techs: techs}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"course": resp})
}

// List handles GET /course/list with filters and sort in query parameters.
func (h CourseHandler) List(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	lang := resolveLang(r.Header.Get("Accept-Language"))
	fieldsParam := r.URL.Query().Get("fields")

	// Parse and validate fields
	f := queryfields.Parse(fieldsParam, queryfields.CoursePreviewAllowedFields)

	// Parse filters and sort from query parameters
	filters, err := parsers.ParseCourseFilters(r, h.Validator)
	if err != nil {
		h.Logger.Warn("Failed to parse course filters", zap.Error(err), zap.String("query", r.URL.RawQuery))
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	sort := parsers.ParseSortOptions(r)
	_, role, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok || !isPositionPrivilegedRole(role) {
		active := domain.CourseStatusActive
		filters.Status = &active
		visible := true
		filters.CatalogVisible = &visible
		filters.CatalogActiveOnly = true
	}

	courses, total, err := h.ListUC.HandleWithFields(r.Context(), lang, f, filters, sort)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}

	// Ensure we return empty array instead of null
	if courses == nil {
		courses = []map[string]any{}
	}

	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{
		"courses": courses,
		"meta":    buildPaginationMeta(filters.Page, filters.Limit, total),
	})
}

// ListCatalog handles GET /catalog/course/list using the authored catalog hierarchy order.
func (h CourseHandler) ListCatalog(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	lang := resolveLang(r.Header.Get("Accept-Language"))
	fieldsParam := r.URL.Query().Get("fields")
	f := queryfields.Parse(fieldsParam, queryfields.CoursePreviewAllowedFields)

	filters, err := parsers.ParseCourseFilters(r, h.Validator)
	if err != nil {
		h.Logger.Warn("Failed to parse catalog course filters", zap.Error(err), zap.String("query", r.URL.RawQuery))
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	active := domain.CourseStatusActive
	visible := true
	filters.Status = &active
	filters.CatalogVisible = &visible
	filters.CatalogActiveOnly = true
	filters.CatalogOrdered = true

	courses, total, err := h.ListUC.HandleWithFields(r.Context(), lang, f, filters, nil)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	if courses == nil {
		courses = []map[string]any{}
	}

	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{
		"courses": courses,
		"meta":    buildPaginationMeta(filters.Page, filters.Limit, total),
	})
}

// ListCatalogScopes handles GET /catalog/scope/list.
func (h CourseHandler) ListCatalogScopes(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	scopes, err := h.ScopeListUC.Handle(r.Context(), resolveLang(r.Header.Get("Accept-Language")))
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	if scopes == nil {
		scopes = []domain.CatalogScope{}
	}

	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"scopes": scopes})
}

func (h CourseHandler) loadCourseMeta(r *http.Request, courseID string) (string, string, any, int, any, error) {
	f := queryfields.Parse("title,description,tags,lesson_count,techs", queryfields.CourseAllowedFields)
	result, err := h.GetUC.HandleByIDWithFields(r.Context(), courseID, f)
	if err != nil {
		return "", "", nil, 0, nil, err
	}

	title, _ := result["title"].(string)
	description, _ := result["description"].(string)

	tags := any([]any{})
	if raw, ok := result["tags"]; ok && raw != nil {
		switch v := raw.(type) {
		case json.RawMessage:
			tags = v
		case []byte:
			if json.Valid(v) {
				tags = json.RawMessage(v)
			}
		case string:
			if json.Valid([]byte(v)) {
				tags = json.RawMessage(v)
			}
		default:
			tags = v
		}
	}

	lessonCount := 0
	if raw, ok := result["lesson_count"]; ok && raw != nil {
		switch v := raw.(type) {
		case int:
			lessonCount = v
		case int32:
			lessonCount = int(v)
		case int64:
			lessonCount = int(v)
		case float64:
			lessonCount = int(v)
		}
	}

	techs := any([]any{})
	if raw, ok := result["techs"]; ok && raw != nil {
		switch v := raw.(type) {
		case json.RawMessage:
			techs = v
		case []byte:
			if json.Valid(v) {
				techs = json.RawMessage(v)
			}
		case string:
			if json.Valid([]byte(v)) {
				techs = json.RawMessage(v)
			}
		default:
			techs = v
		}
	}

	return title, description, tags, lessonCount, techs, nil
}

func (h CourseHandler) handleCourseMetaError(w http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
	if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
		http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
}

func resolveLang(header string) string {
	if header == "" {
		return ""
	}
	parts := strings.Split(header, ",")
	if len(parts) == 0 {
		return ""
	}
	lang := strings.TrimSpace(parts[0])
	if len(lang) >= 2 {
		return strings.ToLower(lang[:2])
	}
	return ""
}
